notes.title: 🐻 Learning to Bear – Launching Soon!
notes.content:
[h2]🐻 Learning to Bear – Coming Soon![/h2]
— A Personal Note —

Hey everyone,

The launch of Learning to Bear is almost here, and before it goes live, I wanted to share a personal note with you.

I’ve spent the last two years building this game on my own—every blueprint, every puzzle, and every little detail. Now, it’s nearly ready for you to experience.

This game is big. It's weird. It's chaotic. And it might be a little too ambitious for just one person. With over 40 levels, layered mechanics, and no handholding, Learning to Bear is all about learning through discovery—just like the theme of the game itself. You’ll be thrown into the unknown and have to figure out how to move forward, step by step.

There’s no handholding instructions. You’ll find things, miss things, and yes, you’ll get stuck—but that’s part of the experience. I’ve tested the game extensively, but with something this complex, there’s always a chance something might slip through. If you encounter any bugs, blockers, or odd behavior, I want to hear about it. Not because I’m worried, but because I’m committed to making this game better with you.

[h2]If you come across any issues or just want to share your thoughts:[/h2]

📬 Report them here on Discord: https://discord.gg/DznGAGQqaY

I’m already working on updates, fixes, and even a level editor, so you can create your own puzzles and challenges. This is just the beginning, and I’m so excited to see where this journey takes us.

Thank you for taking the time to check out this strange little world. The launch is just around the corner, and I really hope you enjoy it.

Bear with me. 🐻

FreQtik
